name: Announcement card
description: A launch or release: a status pill, a big headline, a supporting line and up to three numbered features, on the brand's paper. Ported from the automatos-social announcement family.

eyebrow.label: Eyebrow
eyebrow.description: A short label in the dark pill, e.g. WHY IT MATTERS. Leave empty for none.

status.label: Status
status.description: A short status in the outlined pill, e.g. SHIPPED v2.4. Leave empty for none.

headline.label: Headline
headline.description: The big statement. Use | to break the line, e.g. NEW:|PARALLEL|MISSIONS.

headline_accent.label: Accent words
headline_accent.description: Words of the headline shown in the brand colour, exactly as they appear in it. Leave empty for none.

subline.label: Supporting line
subline.description: One or two sentences under the headline. Leave empty for none.

feature_1_body.label: Feature 1 text
feature_1_body.description: One or two sentences under it.

feature_2_body.label: Feature 2 text
feature_2_body.description: One or two sentences under it.

feature_3_title.label: Feature 3 heading
feature_3_title.description: The heading of feature 3. Leave empty for none.

feature_3_body.label: Feature 3 text
feature_3_body.description: One or two sentences under it. Leave empty for none.

counter.label: Page counter
counter.description: For a post in a series, e.g. 02 / 10. Leave empty for none.

handle.label: Handle
handle.description: The account handle shown top right, e.g. @yourbrand. Leave empty for none.

cta.label: Call to action
cta.description: The footer's call to action, e.g. Read the changelog. Leave empty for none.

sample_data.headline: NEW:|PARALLEL|MISSIONS.
sample_data.subline: Run up to nine agents in parallel on a single Mission. Shared field memory keeps them in sync.
sample_data.feature_1_body: Up to nine specialist agents per Mission, each with its own tools and goal.
sample_data.feature_2_body: Agents read and write one memory band, so they stay in sync without extra orchestration.
sample_data.feature_3_body: Wrap any Playbook step in a Mission block, and it runs as before.
